demos.name: MCP Demo Client for Privilege
demos.description: Chat-first local MCP demo client for protected MCP demos behind a PingOne Privilege gateway: OAuth browser login, tool discovery, raw JSON-RPC, and an LLM lane that shows whether a call routes through the gateway (PRIVILEGE) or direct. Ollama-backed router by default; mock, no tenant needed.
demos.notes: Host-run: npm install && npm start (port 6884; npm run doctor checks it). No docker-compose.yml in this repo; host-run only. Mock works fully offline; Live mode is optional and env-configured (LLM_API_KEY, .env).
